text: Panel 3 seems most different, it looks like the blue box starts almost indented slightly to the right rather than in line with the red box at the bottom. The blue line appears to go a little bit past halfway which is a little longer than a lot of the others and there is only one blue dot present with it. The red boxes at the bottom are both identical width, they're both very narrow. The red line stretches about a third of the way across the panel which is very short in comparison to the others. There are three red dots spread out, none of them are on the line. The other panels all look different and I think even look like they have more dots visible.
